description.brief: Robot 64 edited to be a true test of your knowledge and skill!
description.full: You in for hell? Kaizo Robot 64 is a difficult version of Robot 64 designed to force the usage of many glitches that exist to complete the game. Along with many other challenges. You think you're a Robot 64 professional? Visit this and think again.

description.brief: The hardest of them all. This kaizo pushes precise platforming to its limits. (minimal glitches needed)
description.full:
A Kaizo Robot 64 fangame that is meant to push the skill cap movement tech wise instead of glitch wise.
Gameplay enjoyment is also a huge priority and has had much care put into it, expect it to be good.

description.brief: Just your regular kaizo, with a 2 Dimensional twist.
description.full:
This mod is inspired by many of the Super Mario World kaizo mods, being focused on precise and fun platforming. contains custom mechanics, without changing the Robot 64 movement.
Go through Stages that dont require any glitches, just skilled platforming. These stages may be 2 Dimensional, but the gameplay surely does look sick as hell.

description.brief: A new, fun adventure with a more organic beebo!
description.full:
After destroying the sun, Dr Smar decides to test his building skills. He makes a new Beebo, but this time, he's more organic. That's right, he can bleed just like you and me!

However, this comes with some drawback, you can now break your legs from falling too far, so be careful! Also, since you're kind of like a real person now, everyone hates you too! People will constantly try to hinder with your adventure to collect ice creams for Dr Smar! Expect more boss fights from characters you'd never expect, such as Sheldon Sign, Sheldon Sign, and Sheldon Sign! Speaking of Dr Smar, where is he?
Continuation of Kaizo Robot 64's infamous gauntlet, Final Homerun. This game is one of the hardest fangames out there.

mods.name: hard robot 64 2: the ultimate kazio adventure

description.brief: THIS GAME IS NOT FOR THE WEAK
description.full: seventeen trillion years after hard robot 64, dr. smar is revived and creates a new beebo with literally no moveset upgrades. Beebo is tasked with a mission of collecting ice cream for no reason other than to be cool.
